candidates.change_summary: Replace the balance addition `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` with a subtraction `balances[msg.sender]-= msg.value;`.
Delete the statement `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` so the deposit never updates the balance.
Replace the credited key `msg.sender` with `address(this)` so the deposit is credited to the contract itself.
Replace the added amount `msg.value` with the constant `1` so the deposit always credits exactly 1 wei regardless of the amount sent.
Delete the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so SetMinSum never changes MinSum.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = _val + 1;' so the stored MinSum is off by one.
Invert the guard to 'require(intitalized);' so SetMinSum reverts before initialization and only succeeds after Initialized(), changing when MinSum is set.
Insert 'MinSum = 0;' after the assignment so MinSum is always reset to 0.
Move 'MinSum = _val;' before the require so MinSum is updated even when intitalized is true (where the original reverts).
Remove the require(!intitalized) guard so SetMinSum can be called repeatedly, allowing MinSum to be changed after initialization.
Replace the assignment MinSum = _val with MinSum = 0 so the stored value differs from the passed argument.
Invert the require condition to require(intitalized), so SetMinSum reverts before initialization and MinSum stays 0.
Remove the assignment Log = LogFile(_log); so the Log address stays unset and SetLogFile() returns the original Log value.
Assign Log = LogFile(address(0)) instead of LogFile(_log) so the stored address is always zero.
